verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside WooCommerce that users can hand tasks to. The documented MCP support lets external AI assistants connect to a store, which is a building block for outside agents, not an in-product assistant. A built-in assistant is a fair question for a commerce platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
